plugins.hint: Built-in plugins are free. Install from Path accepts one plugin folder or a parent folder whose subfolders each contain plugin.json. No remote catalog is shipped.

backups.encryption_key_required: Enter an encryption passphrase before uploading to Proton Drive.
backups.proton_configure_hint: Credentials are stored encrypted in SecureStore (never committed). Leave password blank to keep the existing value.
backups.proton_otp_set: OTP secret already set — leave blank to keep

backups.scratch_done: Scratch restore finished in {name}. Production was not modified.
backups.verify_idle: Select a backup to verify checksum or run a restore dry-run.
backups.verify_idle_count: Loaded {count} local backup(s). Verify checksum or dry-run restore before restoring.
backups.verify_missing_checksum: MISSING CHECKSUM — backup has no stored SHA-256 metadata.
backups.dry_run_pass: PASS — dry-run restore succeeded (checksum OK, payload readable).

backups.encryption_tooltip: Enterprise default: encrypt before upload (DSMENC1). Required for Proton Drive backups.
backups.job_in_progress: A backup job is already running. Wait for it to finish.
backups.dry_run_passphrase_required: Encrypted backup: enter the encryption passphrase to run a dry-run restore.
backups.restore_full_tooltip: Overwrites the target database. Needs the backups:restore permission, a typed confirmation, and a safety backup.
backups.size_explainer: Size is the stored file after compression and encryption. “Source DB size” is the live on-disk size when the backup ran (tables + indexes + TOAST). A dump holds only logical data, so a backup is normally much smaller than the Dashboard’s Total size.
backups.size_tip_why: A dump stores logical data only; indexes, free space and bloat are not exported, so it is normally smaller than the Dashboard’s Total size.
backups.size_tip_live: Live database when the backup ran: {size} (tables, indexes, TOAST).
backups.size_tip_legacy: No live size was recorded for this backup (created by an older version).
backups.restore_disabled: Full restore is turned off. Enable it under Settings → Backups & Adapters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.page_subtitle: Theme, language, backups, alerts, updates, and Users & RBAC
settings.reduce_transparency: Reduce transparency (opaque sidebar and sign-in card)
settings.experimental_restore_hint: Full restore is on by default. Unchecking this hides Restore on the Backups tab. A restore overwrites the target database and needs the backups:restore permission, a typed confirmation, and a safety backup.
settings.safe_mode_hint: Blocks destructive SQL (DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE without WHERE) until you confirm.
settings.auto_connect_hint: Reconnects the last used connection when the app starts.
settings.telemetry_hint: Off by default. Nothing leaves this machine unless you turn it on.
settings.adapters_hint: Local backups stay on this machine. Off-machine destinations (Proton Drive, S3) always upload encrypted archives.
settings.experimental_restore: Full restore is available (no longer experimental)
settings.autostart_hint: Watch this connection as soon as the app opens, so a monitoring user gets real-time alerts without clicking Start.
settings.email_hint: Sends critical alerts through your own SMTP server. The password is stored encrypted in SecureStore. Enable the Email channel on the Monitoring tab. Plain SMTP is only allowed for localhost.
settings.adapter_local_detail: Files in the app data folder with a SHA-256 sidecar
settings.adapter_gdrive_detail: Library adapter for scripts and plugins; not offered in the UI (OAuth tokens are too sensitive for a desktop form). Google client libraries installed: {state}
settings.experimental_env_forced: Forced on by the {var} environment variable.
settings.retention_enable: Prune old backups for this rule
settings.retention_hint: Off by default. After a scheduled backup, Local, Proton Drive and S3 copies older than these rules are deleted. Google Drive is not pruned. If both counts are zero, nothing is deleted.
settings.retention_custom: Custom rules for the selected connection
settings.webhook_hint: POSTs a JSON alert to an https URL you control. The URL is stored encrypted and is not written to the notification log. http is only allowed for localhost. Enable Webhook on the Monitoring tab. Same severity and cooldown rules as email.
settings.slack_hint: Posts to a Slack incoming webhook (https://hooks.slack.com). The URL contains a secret and stays in SecureStore. Same severity and cooldown rules as email.
settings.discord_hint: Posts to a Discord incoming webhook (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…). The URL contains a secret and stays in SecureStore. Off until you enable Discord on the Monitoring tab. Same severity and cooldown rules as email.
settings.telegram_hint: Posts through the official Bot API (api.telegram.org only). The bot token and chat id stay in SecureStore and are not written to the notification log. Off until you enable Telegram on the Monitoring tab.
